resources.string: Run dinosour on your computer, then keep this phone on the same Wi-Fi network.
The app finds the computer automatically. If it cannot, type the address shown in the dinosour window on your computer, like http://192.168.1.10:3000.
Looking for dinosour on this Wi-Fi…
No computer found on this Wi-Fi. Tap Open cloud library, or check that dinosour is running on your computer and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
Can\'t reach that server. Try again, or open the cloud library.
dinosour %1$s is ready to install. Your library and settings stay as they are.
Couldn\'t download the update. Try again later.
Android needs your permission to install the update. Tap Settings, allow dinosour, then come back.
